entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I want to return these absolutely terrible cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase, and I apologize for the wait time. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the fit?

A preference issue? Are you kidding me? They've given me painful blisters on both heels! I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, but they just don't fit right. They're garbage and I want a full refund. This is the worst experience I've ever had with VeloFit.
I can certainly understand your frustration; getting blisters from new shoes is the last thing anyone wants. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
It's Robert Chen, order number 78-Alpha-901. You better be able to fix this, or I want to speak to your manager. I'll be leaving reviews everywhere about this.

Thank you, Robert. I see your account now and I appreciate you being a VIP member with us for several years. I assure you, there's no need for a manager; I am fully authorized to handle this for you. Let me just check the policy on these cycling shoes.

Okay, I see the order was delivered 28 days ago. You're in luck. Our standard return policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can process this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh. Well, it should be. 90 days is your policy. So what do I do now?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email in the next five minutes with a pre-paid shipping label. Just package the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay... that's fine. About time something went right.

I completely agree, and again, I am very sorry for the trouble and the blisters they caused. As a token of our apology for the negative experience, and because we truly value you as a VIP customer, I've gone ahead and added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for your next purchase.
A credit? Really? Well... okay. That's... thank you, David. I appreciate you taking care of that. That's good customer service.
You're very welcome, Robert. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. I'll look for that email. Thank you.
Great. It should be in your inbox shortly. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
